lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {V : E → ℝ} {κ : ℝ≥0}, 1 ≤ κ → ContDiff ℝ 2 V → (∀ x v : E, (κ : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ ‖v‖^2) → ∀ {eta c eps : ℝ}, 0 < eta → eta ≤ c → c < 1 → 0 < eps → ∀ (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν], Integrable (fun y => ‖gradient V y‖^2) ν → let T := fun y x : E => y - eta • gradient V x; let C := 2 + (1 + Real.log ((1-c)⁻¹)) / (-Real.log c); ∃ p : E → E, ∃ N : E → ℕ, Measurable p ∧ Measurable N ∧ Measurable (fun y => (T y)^[N y] y) ∧ (∀ y, p y + eta • gradient V (p y) = y ∧ ‖(T y)^[N y] y - p y‖ ≤ eps ∧ Q (gradient V) eta eps y (N y+1) y = some ((T y)^[N y] y, N y+1)) ∧ Integrable (fun y => (N y : ℝ)+1) ν ∧ (∫ y, (N y : ℝ)+1 ∂ν) ≤ C * (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.sqrt (∫ y, ‖gradient V y‖^2 ∂ν) / eps))
approved_definition_context: Q has type (E→E)→R→R→E→N→E→Option(E×N). It is a noncomputable exact-real recursive interpreter. Q g eta eps y 0 x = none. At fuel n+1, set z=y−eta•g(x). If ‖z−x‖≤(1−eta)*eps, return some(x,1); otherwise map (u,k)↦(u,k+1) over Q g eta eps y n z. Thus the returned natural counts one oracle evaluation per test, including success.

Function iteration f^[n] is n-fold composition with f^[0] the identity. NNReal is the nonnegative reals, coerced to R where shown. ContDiff R 2 makes the displayed totalized Frechet derivatives genuine; gradient is the real inner-product gradient.

Measure E is a measure on the displayed measurable space. IsProbabilityMeasure nu means nu has total mass one. Integrable is Bochner integrability; all displayed integrals are real Bochner integrals. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root.
The existential p:E→E and N:E→N are functions of all preceding parameters. Measurable uses the displayed Borel structure on E and the standard measurable structure on N.
